title: BrainJobRequest
description: The optional body of the owner's `POST /brain/{repo}/curate`, `/seed` and `/migrate` (spec-agent-memory-system.md v1.0 section 9). The command is the route, not a body member (spec wins over the demand text, which put `command` in the body). Both members are a per-run experiment override, never stored (B2); an empty body `{}` (or no body) is valid. The note routes (`pin`, `unpin`, `retire`) take no body.
